label: late original-phase positions (t=4-7) after l/c/x/w, content-gated
explanation: Fires only in the original-input phase at absolute steps 4-8 (peak t=5; ~97% of mass), plus weakly on the <DEL> step (3% of mass); never at t<=2 and never during copy. The position window alone covers 99% of mass but has only ~7% precision: within the window, firing depends on sequence content in a distributed way. The strongest content cues are the previous input being l/c/x/w (rate 3-5x), first original token q (3.8x, many top examples start with q), and the current input being a first occurrence. Prev_tok in {l,c,x,w} within t=4-7 gives dev F1 0.29 / mass recall 0.51; adding more tokens or prev2 cues did not help. Magnitude is not well explained beyond the position peak and these token cues.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig2=j (+2.97), prev_tok=l (+2.93), orig2=t (+2.72), prev_tok=c (+2.71), orig0=q (+2.65), orig1=t (+2.48). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.26), phase=2 (-7.36), prev_tok=p (-6.17), prev_tok=j (-4.41).
